findings.title: Native exit codes accept booleans and floats
findings.impact: False and 0.0 are accepted as a successful observed native exit. This violates the required typed-exit evidence contract.
findings.evidence: Exact AST comparison tested: int 0, false and float 0.0 accepted; null and 1 rejected.
findings.fix: Require type(value) is int for each observed native exit before equality to 0; reject absent, boolean, float and unknown statuses.

findings.title: Independent review may predate the execution it accepts
findings.impact: The unchanged _independent function accepts review and owner acceptance on October 2/5 while all supplied dispatches finish October 20. The GLOBAL checks only nest dispatch intervals inside the case interval; no caller binds those intervals to review issuance.
findings.evidence: Real _independent executed with a nonauthoritative FakeReader isolating this function; exact eight verdicts accepted with future dispatch end dates. Same actor and reversed self-reported timestamps rejected.
findings.fix: Bind native producer, dispatch and GLOBAL interval completion to the reviewed evidence cutoff; require all relevant end times <= review issued_at and message received_at; derive clocks from pinned original execution/delivery records.

findings.title: CAS misses additions to the owned raw inventory
findings.impact: The closure requires report owned members to equal owned.rglob("*.raw"), but the dependency snapshot only stores hashes of enumerated files and Source coverage. An extra raw file added after review changes the completeness predicate while Reader.finish and recheck_inputs still pass. Native loops also overwrite read_hashes directly instead of rejecting prior-hash conflicts.
findings.evidence: Real Reader and recheck_inputs called on this review namespace: pin one raw, add unregistered.raw, finish and CAS return PASS. Temporary files removed afterward. closure line176 is the completeness predicate.
findings.fix: Record and recheck owned-directory inventories, including path identity and all members, alongside source inventories. Route all hash registration through one compare-before-register primitive, including streams, members and witnesses.

findings.title: Native execution is not bound to the full current Source21
findings.impact: A native report can provide only six source hashes and pass the trusted closure. The vector may separately pin current product files, but omitted runtime hashes do not demonstrate that this Native run used those current bytes.
findings.evidence: Exact trusted closure CURRENT_SOURCE_CLOSURE_MISMATCH expression accepts six hashes while retrieval.SOURCES has 21; the profile checks only report-provided entries. controls.json lists the omitted 15 sources.
findings.fix: Require the reviewed producer Source21 set exactly and compare every reported source pin with the current vector. Track the producer source inventory as a CAS input; retain full versioned hashes per actual run.

findings.title: Root message receipt is only self-asserted evidence
findings.impact: The delivery JSON has claimed sender, recipient, event_type, content and timestamps but no binding to the original independently delivered message or a trusted Root capture. A packet author can construct the same JSON and satisfy this acceptance predicate.
findings.evidence: The unchanged _independent function accepts an in-memory message with no original origin, message/channel identity or external delivery evidence. This control is explicitly synthetic and grants no authority.
findings.fix: Root must capture the actual independent delivery as a separate trusted provenance record after receipt. Bind its original origin/event identity, sender, message content, review/context hashes and trusted received time; verify this record rather than accepting author-provided claimed fields.
